ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 distribution of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white fields occupy the central regions of both lobes, bifurcated by a low-intensity dark vertical band at the median notch. The right lobe features dense, dark linear streaks and mottling, while the left lobe contains more contiguous white space with isolated dark circular spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical descent relative to the lobe peaks; approximately 40-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations manifest as jagged peaks and valleys, most prominent on the lateral thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Compound curve exhibiting convexity near the median notch transitioning into a concave sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips and along the upper margin of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the right lobe, primarily oriented in diagonal and vertical trajectories.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on the distal margins of both lobes; prominent dark linear scarring on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense and complex dark pigmentation pattern on the right lobe, appearing as a network of intersecting linear marks and blotches.
